COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No.3337 of 2017
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.

There is no representation for the
petitioner.
Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Manoj Kumar, Standing Counsel for
Union of I ndia.

2. Petitioner was nominated as Vice
Chairperson of the Advisory Comm ittee of
Government I ndustrial Training I nstitute vide
Government Order dated 04.01.2017. He was
divested of the charge of Vice Chairperson vide
order dated 30.05.2017 passed by Additional
Chief Secretary, Government of Uttarakhand.
Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioner has
approached this Court challenging the order
dated 30.05.2017.
3. Learned State Counsel submits that
petitioner's appointment as Vice Chairperson
was for a fixed term and, after expiry of the
term, the relief as claimed in the writ petition,
cannot be granted.
4. This Court finds substance in the said
submission. Petitioner was nominated as Vice
Chairperson vide order 04.01.2017. Even if the
term of petitioner's appointment is 5 years,
then also it would have come to an end on
03.01.2022. We are in 2024. Thus, the relief, as
claimed in the writ petition, do not survive.
5. Accordingly the writ petition is dismissed.
( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 06.05.2024
Arpan
